description: The old Roman keeps his gown

participation.context: Kept the gown, named twelve pence as a later price, and went on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Counted four weeks from the ninth of September, and left the gown where it was.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Offered the cover, and stayed when it was refused.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

participation.context: Reported Crack Me from the post, and had the comedy's rolls ready for the morning.
participation.name: Humphrey Larkham

relations.note: he offers the part and does not take it
relations.quote: I shall be at the foot of the stair if the clove slips.

story.body: You kept the Roman part. You heard the Rose title and did not treat it as a visit. You left Cowley on his own peg.

title: Kept the old Roman in Titus
